# Oracle Documentation

> > Comprehensive technical documentation for Oracle products, with primary focus on Java SE, JDK releases, and enterprise development tools.

Oracle's official documentation portal provides authoritative references, tutorials, and guides for Java developers across all experience levels. The site covers Java Platform Standard Edition (SE), Enterprise Edition (EE), embedded platforms, and related Oracle technologies with detailed API references and learning paths.

## Key Topics

- Java SE (Standard Edition)
- JDK (Java Development Kit)
- Java API Reference
- JavaDoc
- Java EE (Enterprise Edition)
- Java Tutorials
- Oracle Database
- Java 8
- JDK 20
- Java Platform Documentation
- Enterprise Development
- Embedded Java
- Release Notes
- Tool Specifications

## Core Java Documentation

- [Java Documentation - Get Started](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java): Java documentation hub covering Java SE, EE, and embedded platforms
- [Java Platform SE 8](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api): Java SE 8 API reference documentation (JavaDoc)
- [The Java™ Tutorials](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/tutorial): Official Java tutorials with learning paths for JDK 8 programmers
- [JDK 20 Documentation - Home](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/20): JDK 20 documentation home with release notes and tool specifications

## Support & FAQs

- [FAQ - How do I delete an existing Note on an account?](https://docs.oracle.com/cd/E69137_01/1.20_oh/FAQ_Notes_How_do_I_delete_an_existing_Note_on_an_account.htm): FAQ explaining how to delete account notes in Oracle system
